goal: Prevent identical address announcements relayed across multiple peers from inflating address multiplicity
agreement: Unaddressed objection: check order causes genuinely newer announcements to be blocked (taki-abedesselam)
Request to clarify and document timestamp updates versus multiplicity increases (danielabrozzoni)
Support because it reduces unwarranted address reference count increases (stratospher)
Concept approval after reproducing the issue with the test (frankomosh)

categories.name: p2p
why: P3 because it fixes a logic bug where identical gossip announcements artificially inflate multiplicity
Limited impact because adversarial peers can trivially alter timestamps to achieve the same inflation
